Until an admin confirms, its {{files}} photos wait in the closest existing folder (shown with →) and move into the new folder automatically once confirmed.

Until an admin confirms, their {{files}} photos wait in the closest existing folder (shown with →) and move into the new folders automatically once confirmed.
